title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
abstract: arXiv:2610.26002v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. translated_title: TimesJev：基于系统1充分性的时间序列快速思考
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）最近在时间序列推理方面展现出强大潜力，而对时间序列进行推理的模型通常依赖长思维链。然而，这一过程往往消耗数千个token，直接导致推理阶段产生显著延迟。相比之下，以Jev为代表的系统1模型能够即时做出决策，自然可以成为一种替代方案，但原始时间序列与这些模型的嵌入空间并不兼容，从而阻碍了推理性能，尤其当输入序列包含数千个数值点时。在本文中，我们进行了非常早期的尝试，提出了一种时间序列系统1模型，即TimesJev。具体而言，我们首先形式化了时间序列推理中的系统1充分性，这启发了保留关键频率模式的时间序列压缩表示。为构建这种表示，我们推导了一个降维目标……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出TimesJev——首个时间序列系统1模型，通过形式化系统1充分性并构建保留关键频率模式的压缩表示，使模型无需长思维链即可对时间序列实现即时推理，从而大幅降低推理延迟。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TimesJev, an early time series System 1 model that formalizes System 1 sufficiency and constructs compressed representations preserving key frequency patterns, enabling instant time series reasoning without long chains of thought and substantially reducing inference latency.
